title: Existence of a Substring in a String and Its Reverse
summary: Determine if a string s contains any substring of length 2 that also appears in the reversed version of s.
statement: Determine if a string s contains any substring of length 2 that also appears in the reversed version of s. Return true if such a substring is found, otherwise return false.
constraints: Consider every contiguous substring of s having length two.
Return whether at least one also occurs as a substring of reversed(s).
A string shorter than two has no qualifying substring.
hints: A pair xy appears in reversed(s) exactly when yx appears in s.
Store all adjacent length-two substrings of s.
Check whether the reverse of any stored pair is also stored.
This equivalence converts the reversed-string search into a complete set membership test.
editorial: This equivalence converts the reversed-string search into a complete set membership test.

tests.explanation: The substring ee occurs unchanged in the reversed string.
The substring ab appears as ba in the original, hence ab occurs in the reverse.
